svg.title: One rea function run, step by step
svg.desc: Six lifelines: you, the rea 6.7.0 one-shot CLI, the BinarySession, the GhidraClient, the headless Ghidra JVM behind bridge.sock, and the artifact ledger-arm64-O1. Twelve numbered rows: rea function _percent_change with --provider ghidra --format json, runDirectAnalysis for analyze_function with the procedure _percent_change, the session parses the Mach-O header and hashes the file in 64 KiB chunks, ghidra is bound with selection source request and profile digest 3fc72c9b4b78498f, the client launches java AnalyzeHeadless with -import, -readOnly and -deleteProject under a 330 second deadline, the file is copied as target-01b5d08b08fb.bin into a private runtime root, the ping handshake returns analysis_complete true after the run_id and token are checked, one JSON line asks analyze_function, the reply carries ok true with the procedure, the pseudocode and 6 instructions, the client returns Evidence ev_b492c85e with confidence observed and 10 limitations, shutdown deletes the project within 10 seconds, and the JSON reaches stdout with exit 0 after 7 to 9 seconds.

g.text: ping handshake, run_id and token checked
7 to 9 s on the capture Mac
